items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves (A/D sideways, W/S vertical). Arrow keys fire tears in that direction; tears travel slowly. E drops a bomb at feet (bomb counter decremented, confirming it fired). Q and Space showed no effect — don't retry. Rocks block movement — step laterally instead of re-pressing. Hatches/doorways need x-centering and a sustained walk from ~0.1–0.2 room-units away; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step back, re-center, re-approach; sometimes several presses). HUD counters lag one observation; HUD layout appears to be coins, bombs, keys — earlier reading of '01 keys' was probably the BOMB count (uncertain).

TECH X / LASER: white pill pickup grants Tech X goggles (white rectangle at player's face, persists across rooms). Firing spawns a lingering (~1s) laser ring at a FIXED OFFSET ≈0.2 room-units in the firing direction (verified by standing ~0.2 below targets; early point-blank misses explainable). Small possible x offset (~-0.03) firing Up. Ring grinds anything overlapping; red cracks on props are NOT damage. Ring destroyed poop piles; did NOT open the torch-room gray chest in 2 sustained trials. Plain tears previously opened gray metal chests at distance. Whether the pill respawns is UNCERTAIN (not visible on a later re-entry).

POOP PILES/DROPS: piles need ~4–6+ ring hits; drops unreliable (coins '$' collected only by near-exact overlap; some gold specks never register). A torch-room pile appeared to regenerate — grinding is unproductive. Two-poop-room piles reset on re-entry.

COINS/PICKUPS: coins need near-exact overlap. Blue orbs = soul hearts. Heart pickup at full hearts gave +1 bomb (earlier). Bomb blasts spawned a blue soul-heart orb in two runs (possible soul-heart source; never stand close). A green gem pickup was sighted in the rock-field — effect UNKNOWN, never collected.

CHESTS: gray chests open by contact or fired tears; give heart and/or bomb; re-close on re-entry. Torch-room central gray chest is enclosed in a tight triangular rock ring whose gaps are narrower than the sprite — contact and firing/ring are blocked; a bomb must clear it (bomb placed directly above the top ring rock; outcome not yet observed). Red-lidded chests and spike-ringed red chest unopened (no key ever seen). White slit/mark on a fired-at chest: meaning UNRESOLVED.

BOMBS: E places at feet, ~1s sparking fuse, radius ~2 tiles; 1.2s retreat was NOT enough (lost a heart); retreat 2s+ or exit through a hatch/room. Clears rock rings; does nothing to white spike rings or decorative cracks.

KEYHOLE DOOR: rock-field left wall ~(0.19,0.44). Repeated sustained walking into it while HUD read 01 did NOT open it; plain tear did nothing; a laser-ring attempt was started but result unobserved. Whether the '01' was keys at all, and whether the door is operable, remains UNCERTAIN and is the leading open test (retest with a confirmed key count).

HAZARDS: rock-field hoppers are the deadliest known enemy: they teleport/arrive at doorways, self-ring with spiky rocks (contact lethal), transform into a winged/spread form, leave green splatter and drifting black-dot projectiles. This run they guarded the top hatch and 1.5 hearts were lost fast at close range — treat the rock-field as a damaging spawner/transit room, stay 2+ tiles clear, avoid the center and the upper-right splatter zone, and leave early rather than exploring. Additional white blob enemies appeared at lower right over time. Dark chest room (black spiders/blobs, melee chasers, laser ineffective) is a heart-draining dead end — AVOID. Corner torches damage on contact; a diagonal path past the bottom-right torch was walked safely. Blue flies in poop rooms hover and fire blue tears (damage unconfirmed). Death = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied sprite.

MAP / ROUTES (confirmed): Tutorial top trapezoid x~0.50 ↔ rock-field (both ways; earlier claim that rock-field's bottom exit was blocked is WRONG — the bottom hatch of the rock-field warps back to the tutorial). Tutorial bottom trapezoid x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; tutorial right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room (avoid). Torch room: top alcove x~0.50 ↔ tutorial (both ways); clear column at top-left lane x~0.31–0.36; bottom gold trapdoor x~0.50 ↔ two-poop room (enter from ~0.1 above the frame, y~0.67–0.70, needs x-center). Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1–0.2 below the frame). Rock-field top exit → TNT room. TNT room: barrels line the left wall blocking lanes; gray chests wedged among them ~y0.30 and ~y0.63; red-lidded brown barrel near the lower one. Beyond TNT: pink-enemy rock room (two pink fat enemies, poop pile with blue flies).

DURABLE GOALS: recover hearts (health has been critically low, 1 heart at last check), obtain bombs, open gray chests (torch-room ringed chest via bomb was the chosen recovery plan), avoid the rock-field center/upper-right and the dark chest room.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door (laser test unobserved) and the red-lidded/spiked chests; whether the HUD '01' was keys or bombs; meaning of the white mark on chests; whether chest contents/coin drops are random per run; whether the Tech X pill respawns; whether lasers can open a chest through a rock ring (current evidence: no); why the torch-room ringed chest resists contact and lasers; effect of the rock-field green gem.
